rugs.ai_description: This is an exquisite antique Persian Kashan rug featuring a central medallion design with intricate floral motifs. The rich color palette includes deep red, ivory, and navy tones, giving it a classic and elegant appearance.
This is a Persian Isfahan rug featuring intricate floral motifs and a traditional design. The rug highlights a cream background with warm earthy tones, characteristic of fine craftsmanship.

This rug features a detailed pictorial design with vibrant depictions of birds and nature, framed by an intricate architectural motif. It is likely of Persian origin, showcasing masterful craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a central medallion and intricate floral motifs in red, gold, and navy. It has a traditional design with a floral border.
This is an elegant antique Persian Mashad rug featuring a central medallion design on a complex field of floral motifs. The rich combination of red, navy, and ivory adds to its classic appeal.
This rug features a traditional Persian design with vibrant red and green colors. It showcases an elaborate floral motif that's typical of the Sultanabad style.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring an intricate all-over pattern. The color palette includes rich tones of navy, gold, and brown, typical of traditional designs.

This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a detailed floral motif and intricate border design. The dominant red and navy colors are complemented by ivory accents, showcasing traditional craftsmanship.
This rug is an exquisite example of an antique Persian Tabriz with a large medallion design featuring intricate floral motifs and a rich color palette.
This is an antique Persian rug featuring a pictorial design with detailed animal motifs and a complex border. The rich red and navy colors highlight the intricate patterns.

This antique Persian rug features a vibrant red field with intricate pictorial scenes and a detailed floral border. The design depicts various human figures, animals, and natural motifs, showcasing a traditional storytelling aesthetic.
This rug features an intricate Persian Isfahan design with a medallion center and floral motifs throughout. Its primary colors include ivory, brown, and blue, exuding a traditional mood.
This rug features a large central medallion with floral motifs, set against a vivid background of rich red and teal colors. The intricate design and faded patina indicate its antique status.
The rug appears to be an antique with visible wear and distinct patterns. It features a combination of muted red, gold, and green colors.
This is a Persian pictorial rug with intricate designs and floral motifs, showcasing a vibrant array of colors. The sophisticated layout features a grid of nature and animal scenes.

This is a Persian pictorial rug featuring detailed portraits and intricate Arabic calligraphy. The central medallion and surrounding motifs depict historical figures, giving the piece a distinct antique charm.
This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a bold central medallion and intricate floral motifs. The primary colors include deep red, blue, and gold, giving it a rich traditional appearance.
This is a semi-antique Persian Kashan rug featuring a detailed floral medallion design. The rug has rich colors including navy, red, and ivory, enhancing its traditional aesthetic.

This rug features a rich red field with intricate floral motifs and palmettes. It exhibits the classic Sultanabad design known for its vibrant color palette and elegant patterns.
This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a central medallion and intricate floral motifs. The primary colors include navy, ivory, and coral, with traditional mood and styling.

This antique Persian Sultanabad rug features an all-over floral motif in soft ivory, blue, and rust shades. Its intricate design is accentuated by a harmonious floral border, embodying a traditional aesthetic.
A stunning antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a rich floral motif in vibrant red, blue, and ivory tones. The intricate design and large scale make it a centerpiece for traditional interiors.
This is a Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a garden panel design with floral and animal motifs. The intricate patterns are highlighted with primary colors of red, ivory, and gold.

This is a vintage Persian Sarouk rug featuring a rich floral motif in navy, red, and green with intricate detailing. It exemplifies traditional craftsmanship and design, making it a timeless addition to any space.
This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a geometric design with a central medallion and ornate borders. The colors include rich navy, ivory, rust, and green.
This is a Persian Bidjar rug known for its durability and dense weave. It features a striking geometric design with rich red and dark tones framed by a floral border.
This rug features intricate floral motifs and a bold color palette of red, navy, and ivory. It exhibits high craftsmanship typical of Persian Tabriz rugs.
This rug features a vibrant red field with a central medallion and geometric designs typical of Heriz style. The intricate patterns and rich colors indicate a Persian origin.

This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a central medallion design with intricate floral motifs and a vibrant color palette of red, navy, and ivory. The detailed border adds to its traditional aesthetic.

This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a rich rust field adorned with intricate floral motifs and a complementary floral border. It showcases a classic traditional design, perfect for elegant interiors.

This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring intricate floral motifs and a detailed border. It displays a warm color palette of red, green, and ivory, typical of its style.

Antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a central medallion with floral motifs in red, green, and navy hues. Its large-scale design and muted palette reflect classic craftsmanship.

This is a vintage Turkish Oushak rug featuring a medallion center and geometric design. It has muted tones with a traditional aesthetic, suitable for adding warmth to a space.

This is an antique Caucasian Heriz rug featuring a geometric medallion design with a deep red field accented by navy and camel tones. The border displays traditional floral motifs, typical of Heriz style.
